chunks: Abu Basir narrated from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام that he said:
"If you give the adhan on the road or in your house, then perform the iqamah in the mosque, it suffices for you."

key_terms.أَجْزَأَكَ: it sufficed for you; it was valid and adequate
key_terms.أَذَّنْتَ: you gave the adhan, the call announcing the prayer
key_terms.أَقَمْتَ: you performed the iqamah, the second call immediately before salat
key_terms.الطَّرِيقِ: the road or way while traveling or en route

ai.seo_question: Is it sufficient to give the adhan at home or on the road and then perform the iqamah in the mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person gives the adhan before reaching the mosque, whether on the road or at home, then performs the iqamah in the mosque, that is sufficient. It indicates a legal allowance concerning the adhan and iqamah in relation to congregational prayer and the mosque setting.
